title: Camp Willow Springs

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: It is our desire that every camper have a fun, safe, and enjoyable experience at Camp Willow Springs. Campers are expected to abide by the camp rules and failure to do so may result in the need for the parent to pick up the camper early. Recognizing the rights and dignity of every person, Youth Camps For Christ does not tolerate bullying and expects every staff person and camper to treat all others with respect. If at any point a camper feels bullied or picked on, please notify a counselor or staff person and/or the Camp Director. blurb: Camp Willow Springs is an interdenominational Christian Camp located on Lake Gaston in northeastern North Carolina. The three-fold purpose of Camp Willow Springs is to win youth to Christ, help mature those who are already Christians and demonstrate that you can be a Christian and have fun.
